dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge exhibits a nearly linear spline with negligible concave curvature from the apex to the posterior base.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded apex with an obtuse morphological profile and a broad pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Anterior margin inclined at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal longitudinal axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base width is approximately 1.7 times the vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-curvature convex arc on the anterior-dorsal boundary with a large radius relative to the cranial height.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered rostrum with a length-to-thickness ratio of approximately 1.5:1 extending from the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Shallow inflection point with a measurable interior angle of approximately 165 degrees at the melon-rostrum junction.

other_distinctive_markers: Uniform emissive cyan-teal pixel intensity across the entire morphological surface isolated against a zero-value black background.
